project_type: Three-package full-stack monorepo WITHOUT npm workspaces: frontend/ (React 18 + Vite SPA, deploys to Vercel), backend/ (Node 22 + Express 4 agent API, deploys to Render), submission/ (Node PDF/screenshot scripts). A shared/ folder is the single source of truth for the guide zod schema and 14 curated guide JSON files; scripts/sync-shared.mjs copies it into frontend/src/generated and backend/src/generated (both gitignored) before every dev/build/test/typecheck.
language: TypeScript (frontend strict + bundler resolution; backend strict + NodeNext). Build/sync/link/PDF scripts are plain ESM .mjs with zero dependencies except submission (puppeteer, marked).
build_system: Per-package npm, no workspaces. Each package has its own package.json, .npmrc (save-exact=true) and committed package-lock.json. All dependency versions are PINNED EXACTLY in design.md 'Technology stack (locked)' and MUST be used verbatim (no ^ or ~). Root package.json holds convenience scripts only (sync, check:links, pdf, screenshots) and has no dependencies. Quirks: frontend tsconfig MUST keep skipLibCheck:true (drei pulls hls.js types that TS 5.6.3 rejects); backend tsconfig uses NodeNext so relative imports need .js extensions; generated curatedGuides.ts imports './schema.js' for BOTH targets.
test_framework: vitest 2.1.5 in both frontend (jsdom + @testing-library) and backend (node env + supertest). Backend tests live in backend/test/**/*.test.ts (outside tsconfig include, transpiled by vitest). Frontend tests are co-located *.test.tsx/*.test.ts. check-links and a real keyed end-to-end run are manual/network and NOT part of `npm test`.
build_command: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs; npm --prefix backend run build; npm --prefix frontend run build  (each package's pre* script also runs the sync). Windows PowerShell: use ; not &&, prefer npm --prefix over cd.
test_command: npm --prefix backend test; npm --prefix frontend test  (plus `node scripts/check-links.mjs` for AC 3, which needs network).
verification_instructions: 1) node scripts/sync-shared.mjs exits 0. 2) npm --prefix backend run build exits 0; npm --prefix backend test all pass (ACs 1-13,23,25). 3) npm --prefix frontend run build exits 0 (AC 14); npm --prefix frontend test all pass (ACs 16-20). 4) node scripts/check-links.mjs exits 0 with zero broken/missing (AC 3). 5) Deep-link /guides/github against a BACKGROUNDED `vite preview` on :4173 renders the guide, then stop the preview (AC 15). 6) git grep -nE "sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20}|tvly-[A-Za-z0-9]{10}" returns nothing (AC 25). 7) node submission/build-pdf.mjs (or --draft while links.config.json holds placeholders) produces submission/Composio_OAuth_Guide_Agent_Submission.pdf < 10MB with all sections (AC 24). NEVER run dev servers/watchers in the foreground — start as background processes, probe, then stop.
snapshot_or_generated_files: scripts/sync-shared.mjs generates frontend/src/generated/{schema.ts,curatedGuides.ts} and backend/src/generated/{schema.ts,curatedGuides.ts} (gitignored). scripts/check-links.mjs generates shared/link-check-report.json (COMMITTED — feeds the PDF LINK_CHECK_TABLE). Lockfiles (package-lock.json in backend/frontend/submission) are committed. The final PDF submission/Composio_OAuth_Guide_Agent_Submission.pdf and submission/screenshots/*.jpg are committed outputs. Regenerate generated/ with `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs`; regenerate the report with `node scripts/check-links.mjs`.
environment_constraints: OS Windows, shell PowerShell 5.1 — use ; not &&, quote paths with spaces (the repo is under a OneDrive path with spaces). Node v22.21.0 / npm 10.9.4 installed locally. DO NOT commit or push and DO NOT create a git worktree (work directly in the repo). Never run dev servers/watchers in the foreground; start them backgrounded, probe, then stop. Live deploy URLs are unknown at build time (requirements A2) — the PDF reads them from submission/links.config.json placeholders; use build-pdf.mjs --draft until filled. API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY) are NOT required to build/test/serve curated library (A1); live generation returns 503 CONFIG_MISSING without them. Puppeteer on Windows: fall back to Chrome/Edge executable paths or PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH; retry once on EBUSY (OneDrive lock).
contribution_requirements: Conform EXACTLY to .agents/tasks/requirements.md (ACs 1-25) and .agents/tasks/design.md (revision 3). Do NOT reopen or edit the design/requirements docs. Use pinned versions verbatim with save-exact and commit lockfiles (NFR5). All npm scripts must run on both Windows PowerShell and Linux — no bash-only syntax (NFR6). No secrets in the repo; .env.example lists every var without values; .gitignore must ignore .env* except .env.example. Honesty over polish in curated content: a section is 'verified' only when backed by an official source URL that passes the link checker.
key_patterns: Wire protocol (StreamEvent union, ErrorCode/ClientErrorCode, ApiErrorBody) is typed ONCE in shared/schema.ts and used by both apps. GuideDraftSchema (LLM-facing, strict Structured Outputs: every field required, optionals become .nullable(), NO .optional/.url/.regex/.min/.max/.default/.refine) is separate from GuideSchema (full validation). normalizeDraft coerces strict LLM output to GuideSchema input (null/empty-after-trim optional strings -> undefined because zod .optional() rejects ''). The store layer owns re-validation (every get() does GuideSchema.safeParse -> null on failure). classify(err, signal) checks signal.aborted FIRST. Confidence per section = min(draft, verifier), then verified->community when no official sourceRef. Verified against current docs on 2026-10-20: Tavily uses POST https://api.tavily.com/{search,extract} with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; OpenAI structured outputs via zodResponseFormat need the strict subset (additionalProperties:false, all keys required, nullable not optional).
